title: 都市滯洪池配置~Urban detention-basin planning
focus: 以事件體積、出流時間與下游條件配置都市滯洪~Planning urban detention through event volume release timing and downstream conditions
summary: 課程從連通集水區和事件體積進入儲量演算，逐項建立池容、孔口、溢流、滲透與排空模型，最後檢查下游峰時、沉積和數值閉合。大坑東與跑馬地提供地下蓄洪實例，全部數值為合成假設；規劃的核心是保存水量與確認去向，不把單一削峰百分比當完整防洪成效。~The course moves from connected catchment and event volume into storage routing, geometry, orifices, overflow, infiltration and drawdown, then checks downstream timing, sediment and numerical closure. Tai Hang Tung and Happy Valley provide underground-storage examples. All numbers are synthetic assumptions; planning centers on conservation and destination rather than treating one peak-reduction percentage as complete flood performance.

units.anchor: 集水區與逕流體積~Catchment and runoff volume
units.title: 集水區與逕流體積機理與驗證~Catchment and runoff volume mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 滯洪池的第一個問題是哪些地表真正連到入口，而不是行政邊界內有多少面積。屋頂、道路和透水地的產流不同，前期含水與管網分流又會改變有效貢獻；事件總量可用簡化係數作初估，但它沒有提供洪峰出現時間或歷線形狀，不能單靠總雨量完成池容設計。本例係數為指定事件的體積比例，假設雨量均勻且無跨區來水；它不是用於求瞬時洪峰的完整理性式分析。~The first detention question is which surfaces actually connect to the inlet, not how much area lies inside an administrative boundary. Roofs, roads and permeable land generate different runoff, while antecedent wetness and network diversion change effective contribution. An event coefficient provides an initial volume estimate but not crest timing or hydrograph shape, so rainfall total alone cannot size the basin. The coefficient is a specified event-volume fraction under uniform rainfall and no imported flow. This is not a complete rational-method peak-flow analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設事件雨量P=0.050 m、連通面積A=200000 m²、體積逕流係數C=0.70，V=CPA=7000 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume event rainfall P=0.050 m, connected area A=200000 m² and volume runoff coefficient C=0.70. Runoff V=CPA=7000 m³.
units.verify: 以排水連通調查核對有效面積，將雨量與入口事件體積比較，分開記錄跨區分流和前期含水。檢查係數是否隨事件改變，並補上時間分布資料才能進行真正的滯洪演算。~Verify connected area through drainage mapping and compare rainfall with measured inlet event volume, recording imported flow and antecedent wetness separately. Check event-to-event coefficient changes and obtain temporal distribution before using the volume estimate in actual detention routing.
units.failure: 把整個集水區都當不透水會高估部分情境，漏掉管網跨區來水則可能低估；即使事件總量正確，不同雨型仍可能產生完全不同的峰值與需要庫容。~Treating the whole catchment as impervious overestimates some cases, while omitted network imports underestimate others. Even a correct event volume can produce very different peaks and storage requirements under different rainfall timing.
units.misconception: 知道總雨量與總面積後，就能唯一決定所需滯洪池容量。~Total rainfall and total area uniquely determine the required detention capacity.
units.practice: 畫出行政界和實際排水界，辨認一條跨界管線對體積帳的影響。為相同事件雨量安排兩種時間分布，說明為何後續必須比較完整入流歷線。~Draw administrative and drainage boundaries and identify the effect of one cross-boundary pipe on the volume ledger. Arrange two temporal patterns for equal rainfall and explain why complete inflow hydrographs must subsequently be compared.

units.anchor: 歷線演算與儲量變化~Hydrograph routing and storage change
units.title: 歷線演算與儲量變化機理與驗證~Hydrograph routing and storage change mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 滯洪利用進出流量的時間差暫存水量，所需最大庫容來自累積差額而不是洪峰流量相減。出口流量又依池水位與下游水位變化，使儲量和出流彼此耦合；若只固定一個出流上限而不限制可用水量，演算可能在池空時仍排水，產生不可能的負儲量。本例以一個時間步的已知端點流量作梯形積分，假設步內線性變化且儲量足夠；未求完整水位依存出口。~Detention stores the time-integrated difference between inflow and outflow, not the difference of peak discharges alone. Outlet flow depends on basin and downstream stages, coupling storage and release. A fixed outflow cap without water-availability constraints can continue releasing from an empty basin and create physically impossible negative storage. The example trapezoidally integrates known endpoint flows over one step, assuming linear variation and sufficient water. It does not solve a complete stage-dependent outlet.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=300 s、入流I1=4、I2=6及出流O1=2、O2=3 m³/s，ΔS=[(I1+I2)−(O1+O2)]Δt/2=750 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=300 s, inflows I1=4, I2=6 and outflows O1=2, O2=3 m³/s. Storage change ΔS=[(I1+I2)−(O1+O2)]Δt/2=750 m³.
units.verify: 逐步核對入流、出流、初始和最終儲量，確認流量時間戳與積分區間一致。縮小時間步比較最大水位及峰值時刻，並檢查池空、滿溢與逆流時的邊界切換是否守恆。~Reconcile inflow, outflow and initial/final storage step by step, aligning timestamps with integration intervals. Reduce the time step to compare maximum stage and crest timing, and check conservation when boundaries switch at empty storage, overflow or reverse flow.
units.failure: 將立方公尺每秒差額直接當池容積會漏掉時間量綱，過大時間步又可能跨過短時峰值；未處理池空邊界會製造不存在的排水量和虛假削峰效益。~Using a discharge difference as storage omits time dimensions, and overly large steps can skip a brief peak. Missing the empty-basin boundary invents discharge and produces a false attenuation benefit.
units.misconception: 所需滯洪容積就是最大入流減去最大出流，不需要積分時間。~Required detention volume is maximum inflow minus maximum outflow without time integration.
units.practice: 用四個時間步建立累積儲量，讓最後一步可能排空並修正不可能出流。將修正前後的總水量比較，指出負儲量不是可接受的數值小誤差。~Build cumulative storage over four steps, allowing the last to empty the basin and correcting impossible outflow. Compare total water before and after correction and explain why negative storage is not an acceptable small numerical error.

units.anchor: 水位面積與有效池容~Stage area and usable storage
units.title: 水位面積與有效池容機理與驗證~Stage area and usable storage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 滯洪池的平面面積可隨水位增加，邊坡、柱體及設備又會改變有效蓄水空間。面積曲線積分才得到庫容，不能用最高水位面積乘水深代替所有幾何；永久水池、沉砂區與不可抽空部分也應從可用調洪容積分開，避免以總挖方體積宣稱防洪能力。本例採線性水位面積關係且從指定空池基準積分，未含柱體或死水容積；實際幾何需由測量和竣工資料建立。~Basin surface area may grow with stage, while slopes, columns and equipment alter usable space. Integrating the area curve yields storage; maximum surface area times depth does not represent all geometries. Permanent pools, sediment reserves and undrainable zones must also be separated from available flood storage instead of equating excavation volume with flood capacity. The example integrates a linear stage-area relation from a specified empty datum, excluding columns and dead storage. Actual geometry needs survey and as-built records.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A(h)=1000+200h m²，其中h以m計；到h=2 m的庫容S=1000h+100h²=2400 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A(h)=1000+200h m² with h in meters. Storage at h=2 m is S=1000h+100h²=2400 m³.
units.verify: 核對面積曲線的標高基準與插值方式，將分層積分容積和三維幾何模型比較。另列永久水位、沉積及構件占用，確認演算使用可動用的庫容，而不是圖面標示的總空間。~Check elevation datum and interpolation of the area curve, comparing layered integration with three-dimensional geometry. List permanent water, deposits and structural displacement separately, confirming that routing uses accessible storage rather than the gross space labeled on a drawing.
units.failure: 用頂面積乘深度會對向上擴張池體高估容積，漏掉柱體或既有積水也會虛增可用量；基準不一致時甚至可能把同一段水深重複計入。~Multiplying top area by depth overstates storage in an expanding basin. Omitted columns or initial water also inflate available capacity, and inconsistent datums can cause the same depth interval to be counted twice.
units.misconception: 池頂平面面積乘總深度永遠等於可用滯洪容量。~Top plan area times total depth always equals usable detention storage.
units.practice: 對線性面積曲線做分層與解析兩種積分，再扣除一個假設永久水位以下體積。說明最高水位不變時，初始積水如何減少可用調洪容量。~Integrate the linear area curve numerically and analytically, then subtract volume below a hypothetical permanent level. Explain how initial water reduces available flood storage even when the maximum permitted stage is unchanged.

units.anchor: 孔口出流與尾水~Orifice release and tailwater
units.title: 孔口出流與尾水機理與驗證~Orifice release and tailwater mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 池底孔口把水頭轉為出流速度，流量取決於有效開口、流量係數及兩側能量差。自由出流時可由孔心到池水面估水頭，但下游淹沒後必須改用兩側水頭差；入口垃圾和沉積也會改變有效面積，不能把設計孔徑永久視為可用開口。本例是淹沒薄孔的簡化定常流，指定係數與兩側水頭差，忽略接管沿程損失；不推定任何產品或許可排量。~A low-level orifice converts head to outlet velocity according to effective opening, discharge coefficient and energy difference. For free discharge the basin surface-to-orifice-center head may be used, but submerged discharge requires the difference between both sides. Debris and deposits alter effective area, so nominal diameter cannot be treated as permanently available opening. The example is simplified steady flow through a submerged thin orifice with specified coefficient and differential head, excluding downstream pipe friction and any product or permit rating.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、開口A=0.10 m²、兩側水頭差ΔH=1.0 m、g=9.81 m/s²，Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, opening A=0.10 m², differential head ΔH=1.0 m and g=9.81 m/s². Flow Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s.
units.verify: 同時量測池內與下游水位，核對孔心高程、開口和係數來源。比較清潔、部分堵塞與尾水上升的出流資料，確認模型在自由與淹沒狀態切換時不會突然創造或消失流量。~Measure basin and downstream stages together, checking orifice elevation, opening and coefficient source. Compare clean, partially blocked and rising-tailwater observations, ensuring that switching between free and submerged representations does not abruptly create or remove flow in the model.
units.failure: 尾水升高仍用池深當水頭會高估出流而低估池水位，忽略堵塞則讓維護不足被掩蓋；水頭差反向時，未設防倒流的開口可能反而進水。~Using basin depth despite high tailwater overstates release and understates basin stage. Ignored blockage conceals maintenance loss, and reversed differential head can admit water through an opening without backflow protection.
units.misconception: 孔口流量只和池內水深有關，下游水位升高不會影響。~Orifice discharge depends only on basin depth and is unaffected by downstream water level.
units.practice: 保持池水位不變而提高尾水，計算兩個水頭差的出流量。再將有效面積減半，區分堵塞和尾水兩種原因如何在量測上辨認。~Hold basin stage fixed while raising tailwater and calculate releases at two differential heads. Then halve effective area, distinguishing the observations needed to separate blockage from a tailwater-driven reduction.

units.anchor: 超量溢流與越頂路徑~Exceedance overflow and routes
units.title: 超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證~Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 滯洪池遇到超過控制出口能力的事件時，需要辨認水會流向何處，正常出流設計不能代表超量情境。溢流堰流量與堰頂以上水頭呈非線性，來流速度、淹沒與側向幾何會改變係數；更重要的是溢出後的路徑和受影響空間，不能只證明池內水位降低而忽略下游風險。本例用指定係數的自由矩形堰比較，係數已包含單位；未模擬側堰、淹沒或街道二維流動。~When an event exceeds the controlled outlet, the overflow destination matters; normal-release design does not represent exceedance behavior. Weir flow is nonlinear in head above crest, and approach velocity, submergence and lateral geometry alter the coefficient. The route and exposed spaces downstream must be assessed rather than claiming success merely because basin level is reduced. The example uses a free rectangular weir with a specified dimensional coefficient, excluding side-weir behavior, submergence and two-dimensional street flow.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=Cw bH^1.5，Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s、堰寬b=2.0 m、水頭H=0.30 m，Q=0.5587 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=Cw bH^1.5, Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=2.0 m and head H=0.30 m. Overflow Q=0.5587 m³/s.
units.verify: 測量堰頂、相鄰低點和下游路徑，核對流量係數及淹沒範圍。以超量事件追蹤地面流向和深度，確認出口不導向脆弱空間，並保留正常出口堵塞時的獨立情境。~Survey crest, adjacent low points and downstream routes, checking coefficient basis and submergence. Track surface direction and depth during exceedance, verifying that overflow does not lead toward vulnerable spaces, and retain a separate scenario for blockage of the normal outlet.
units.failure: 把溢流量視為無害排出會漏掉街道或地下室的暴露，忽略鄰近較低缺口則可能使實際溢流繞過設計堰；下游回水還能降低溢流能力。~Treating overflow as harmless removal overlooks street or basement exposure. A nearby lower gap may bypass the intended weir, and downstream backwater can further reduce the available overflow capacity.
units.misconception: 只要設置溢流堰，超量洪水就已經有安全去處而不必追蹤。~An overflow weir automatically gives excess floodwater a safe destination without route analysis.
units.practice: 在地形圖標出設計溢流口和其他低點，為同一水位比較可能先出流的位置。用簡化堰式計算後，列出仍需地表流模型回答的深度與速度問題。~Mark the designed overflow and other low points on a terrain map and compare which can spill first at one stage. After a weir calculation, identify depth and velocity questions still requiring surface-flow analysis.

units.anchor: 滲透折減與前期飽和~Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation
units.title: 滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證~Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 透水滯洪池可讓部分水進入地層，但滲透能力會受到前期含水、地下水位、細粒堵塞與土層連續性控制。短時間現地試驗不能直接代表長期暴雨條件，尤其地下水接近池底時，向下水力梯度可能減小；將滲透當作永遠固定的額外出口，可能低估連續降雨所需庫容。本例使用指定均勻入滲速率作體積尺度，沒有採用實測保證值；飽和、污染控制或襯底條件可能使可計入滲透為零。~A permeable basin can infiltrate some water, but antecedent wetness, groundwater, fine-particle clogging and stratigraphy control that capacity. A short field test does not necessarily represent prolonged rainfall, particularly when groundwater approaches the floor and downward gradient weakens. Treating infiltration as a permanently fixed extra outlet can understate storage needed during successive storms. The example uses a specified uniform infiltration rate as a volume scale, not a guaranteed field value. Saturation, contamination controls or lining may reduce creditable infiltration to zero.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h. Infiltrated volume Vi=Aft=10.0 m³.
units.verify: 在代表土層與季節進行入滲和地下水觀測，將試驗持續時間、前期含水與堵塞狀態記錄完整。比較可計入與零滲透兩個情境，並確認水質或襯底需求不與假設滲透功能衝突。~Observe infiltration and groundwater in representative strata and seasons, documenting test duration, antecedent wetness and clogging state. Compare credited-infiltration and zero-infiltration cases, checking that water-quality or lining requirements do not contradict the infiltration function assumed by the storage model.
units.failure: 以乾季初始入滲率外推連續暴雨會高估損失，孔隙堵塞又可能逐年降低能力；只計入滲優點而未檢查地下水與水質，會形成不完整的工程比較。~Extrapolating dry-season initial infiltration through prolonged storms overstates losses, while clogging can reduce performance over years. Counting infiltration benefits without groundwater and water-quality checks produces an incomplete engineering comparison.
units.misconception: 透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。~A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage.
units.practice: 把指定滲透體積與事件逕流體積比較，判斷它在此假設下的相對影響。將入滲設為零重新演算，說明哪些場地證據才能支持恢復部分折減。~Compare the specified infiltration volume with event runoff to assess its relative influence under these assumptions. Rerun with zero infiltration and identify site evidence needed before restoring any infiltration credit.

units.anchor: 變水頭排空時間~Drawdown under changing head
units.title: 變水頭排空時間機理與驗證~Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 孔口排水會隨水位下降而減慢，因此以初始最大出流除池容會低估排空時間。若後續降雨在池尚未恢復容量時到達，前一場殘留水會改變下一場峰值；排空策略需同時考慮下游容許出流和連續事件，而非只追求單場暴雨結束後最快放空。本例池面積固定、無入流與滲透、自由孔口小到可用孔心水頭近似，積分到仍為正的水頭；不外推到孔口部分露出階段。~Orifice release slows as stage falls, so dividing storage by the initial maximum discharge understates drawdown time. A second storm arriving before recovery encounters less available storage. Drawdown planning must therefore consider downstream release constraints and successive events rather than simply emptying as quickly as possible after one storm. The example assumes constant basin area, no inflow or infiltration and a small free orifice described by center head, integrating only to a positive head before partial uncovering.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池面積Ab=1000 m²、Cd=0.62、孔面a=0.10 m²、h1=2.0、h2=0.20 m，t=2Ab(√h1−√h2)/(Cd a√(2g))=7042 s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume basin Ab=1000 m², Cd=0.62, orifice a=0.10 m², h1=2.0, h2=0.20 m and g=9.81 m/s². Drawdown t=7042 s.
units.verify: 用不同水位下實測出流檢查孔口關係，核對排空期間是否仍有管網入流或尾水抬升。比較積分解與逐步演算，並確認終止水頭仍符合孔口完整淹沒的幾何假設。~Check the outlet relation using measured releases at several stages and identify continuing network inflow or rising tailwater during drawdown. Compare the integrated solution with stepwise routing, verifying that the final head still satisfies the assumed geometry of a fully covered opening.
units.failure: 以初始流量當全程固定會低估恢復容量所需時間，忽略尾水或再降雨更會過度樂觀；積分到孔口露出後仍沿用同式，則超出原有流況。~Holding the initial discharge constant understates recovery time, and omitted tailwater or renewed rainfall makes it more optimistic. Continuing the same equation after the opening becomes exposed extends it beyond the assumed flow regime.
units.misconception: 孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。~Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release.
units.practice: 比較固定初始流量估計與變水頭積分結果，畫出排水逐漸減慢的曲線。讓第二場雨在恢復前到達，指出演算必須保留的初始儲量。~Compare a fixed-initial-flow estimate with changing-head integration and plot the slowing release. Introduce a second storm before recovery and identify the initial storage that must carry into the new routing calculation.

units.anchor: 下游匯流與峰值錯時~Downstream combination and peak timing
units.title: 下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證~Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 單一池出口削峰不一定降低流域最下游峰值，因延後的出流可能剛好與另一支流洪峰重疊。配置池址和出流歷線時應在共同時間軸上做河網演算，不能把各支流最大值不加區分地相加；也不能只比較工程前後同一個時刻而忽略新峰值出現時間。本例在匯流點忽略傳播延遲與局部儲水，只示範同時流量相加；完整流域需先把各歷線演算至同一位置。~Attenuation at one basin outlet does not necessarily reduce the furthest downstream peak: delayed release may coincide with another tributary crest. Basin siting and release hydrographs require routing on a shared time axis. Adding separate maxima ignores timing, while comparing only one preselected instant can miss a new peak occurring later. The example neglects travel time and local storage at a junction and demonstrates only simultaneous addition. Full-basin work must route each hydrograph to the same location first.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩支流在時刻t1為8與2 m³/s、t2為3與7 m³/s，兩時刻合流皆10 m³/s；各自峰值相加15 m³/s並非同時峰值。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume tributaries are 8 and 2 m³/s at t1, then 3 and 7 m³/s at t2. Both totals are 10 m³/s; adding separate peaks gives 15 m³/s without concurrence.
units.verify: 將各支流與池出口時間戳統一並校核傳播時間，在匯流點比較完整工程前後歷線。檢查峰值時刻、持續時間及受納水位，而不是只記錄池出口的單一削峰百分比。~Align tributary and basin-outlet timestamps and verify travel times before comparing complete pre- and post-project hydrographs at the junction. Examine crest timing, duration and receiving stage instead of reporting only one attenuation percentage measured at the basin outlet.
units.failure: 延遲出流若與另一支流同時達峰，可能把局部改善轉成下游負擔；直接加各峰值會高估某些情境，但忽略時間變化也可能漏掉真正最不利組合。~Delayed release can coincide with another tributary crest and transfer a local improvement downstream. Adding separate maxima overstates some scenarios, but ignoring changing timing can also miss the truly unfavorable combination.
units.misconception: 每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。~Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus.
units.practice: 把一支出流歷線平移一個時間步，重新計算匯流而不改總體積。比較局部峰值和下游峰值，說明時間配置為何是池址規劃的一部分。~Shift one release hydrograph by one step without changing volume and recompute junction flow. Compare local and downstream peaks, explaining why temporal alignment is part of basin planning rather than a secondary plotting detail.

units.anchor: 沉積與可用容量維持~Sediment and retained capacity
units.title: 沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證~Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 滯洪池會接收顆粒與垃圾，沉積不僅占去容積，也可能堵塞出口或改變入流分配。總容量衰減與局部水力失效是不同路徑，平均薄層估算不能代表出口附近的堆積；維護應以測量、出流能力和可清理性共同評估，而不是等到池完全填滿才處理。本例沉積層厚度均勻且直接扣除有效容積，未模擬固結或出流堵塞；真實局部影響可能比體積比例更早主導。~Detention basins receive particles and debris that occupy volume, obstruct outlets and redistribute incoming flow. Bulk storage loss and localized hydraulic failure are different mechanisms, and a mean thin-layer estimate does not represent deposits near an outlet. Maintenance should combine survey, outlet performance and cleaning access rather than wait until the entire basin fills. The example subtracts a uniform deposit layer from usable storage without consolidation or outlet blockage. Local hydraulic effects may govern before the bulk volume fraction becomes large.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池底A=1000 m²、平均沉積厚度d=0.15 m，損失Vd=Ad=150 m³；原可用2400 m³剩2250 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume floor A=1000 m² and mean deposit thickness d=0.15 m. Lost Vd=Ad=150 m³; initial usable 2400 m³ becomes 2250 m³.
units.verify: 以固定基準測深並標出出口附近的局部堆積，將清淤量與容積曲線更新對帳。另測正常出口能力及垃圾攔截狀態，確認容量恢復和水力通暢都已驗證而非只完成清理作業。~Survey deposits on a fixed datum and map local buildup near the outlet, reconciling removed volume with the updated storage curve. Independently check normal-release capacity and debris control so that both recovered storage and hydraulic openness are verified, not merely the completion of cleaning work.
units.failure: 只扣平均沉積容積會漏掉孔口先被堵塞的情況，未更新模型則持續高估可用池容；清淤若只移動泥砂到另一區，也不代表總有效容量已恢復。~Subtracting mean deposit volume misses an outlet blocked first, while an unchanged model continues to overstate storage. Moving sediment to another part of the basin does not necessarily restore total usable capacity.
units.misconception: 只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。~A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance.
units.practice: 比較均勻沉積和集中堵住孔口兩種同體積情境，分別更新池容與出流關係。說明為何維護績效需要容量和水力兩個指標，而不是只報清出重量。~Compare uniform deposition with the same volume concentrated at the orifice, updating storage and release relations separately. Explain why maintenance performance needs both capacity and hydraulic indicators rather than only removed mass.

units.anchor: 數值水量閉合與收斂~Numerical closure and convergence
units.title: 數值水量閉合與收斂機理與驗證~Numerical closure and convergence mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 雨洪模型的水量閉合檢查能發現漏列出流、時間積分或邊界處理問題，但閉合良好不代表洪峰位置或水位一定正確。粗網格和粗時間步可能保住總體積卻錯過短時高水位，錯誤糙率也能得到漂亮收支；因此守恆、時間收斂與獨立事件驗證應分開進行。本例殘差定義為入流減出流再減儲量增加，百分比以總入流作分母；正殘差只表示未解釋水量，並不直接指出物理漏水位置。~A water-balance check can reveal missing outlets, integration problems or boundary errors, but good closure does not prove correct peak timing or stage. Coarse grids and time steps can preserve volume while missing brief high water, and wrong roughness may still yield a neat balance. Conservation, temporal convergence and independent-event validation therefore require separate checks. Residual is inflow minus outflow minus storage increase, normalized by total inflow. A positive residual is unexplained water and does not locate a physical leak.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設事件入流Vi=10000 m³、出流Vo=7600 m³、儲量增ΔS=2350 m³，殘差R=50 m³，即入流的0.50%。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume event inflow Vi=10000 m³, outflow Vo=7600 m³ and storage increase ΔS=2350 m³. Residual R=50 m³, or 0.50% of inflow.
units.verify: 列出所有水量項與正負號，核對初始儲量、溢流、滲透和反向流是否都有計入。逐次縮小時間步比較最大水位和峰時，再以獨立事件檢查參數，避免只以殘差達標宣告模型有效。~List all terms with signs, checking initial storage, overflow, infiltration and reversed flow. Progressively reduce time steps to compare maximum stage and peak time, then assess parameters against an independent event rather than declaring validity solely from a small residual.
units.failure: 將未列溢流當數值誤差會掩蓋真實外排，反之把數值殘差當漏水又會誤導維護；只校正總體積而不查水位歷線，可能得到錯誤的池容配置。~Calling omitted overflow numerical error hides actual discharge, while interpreting numerical residual as leakage misdirects maintenance. Calibrating total volume without examining stage trajectories can produce the wrong basin configuration.
units.misconception: 模型水量誤差很小，就等於峰值水位和所有設計判斷都正確。~A small model water-balance error proves correct peak stage and every design decision.
units.practice: 製作三種時間步的水量殘差與最大水位比較表，讓其中一種總量相近但漏掉尖峰。說明要保留哪幾項證據，才能同時支持守恆和峰值解析度。~Compare water residual and maximum stage at three time steps, including one that preserves volume but misses a sharp peak. Identify the evidence needed to support both conservation and adequate resolution of the maximum.

example: 敏感度固定孔口係數Cd=0.62與兩側水頭差1.0 m，只把圓孔直徑增加10%。面積和瞬時流量都增加21%，若原開口0.10 m²的流量為0.2746 m³/s，新面積0.121 m²對應0.3323 m³/s。這可能較快恢復池容，但也可能增加下游負荷；在同一固定池面積及自由排水積分模型下，排空時間因面積增加而降為原值的82.64%。實際事件的水位會隨出流改變，尾水和部分淹沒也可能變動，因此不能直接用固定水頭比例取代全歷線重算。~For sensitivity, hold Cd=0.62 and differential head at 1.0 m while increasing circular-orifice diameter by ten percent. Area and instantaneous discharge both rise by 21%. An original 0.10 m² opening releases 0.2746 m³/s; the new 0.121 m² opening releases 0.3323 m³/s. This can restore storage sooner but also increases downstream loading. Under the same constant-area, free-drawdown integral model, time falls to 82.64% of its original value. Real event stage responds to release, while tailwater and submergence may change. The fixed-head ratio therefore cannot replace rerouting the complete hydrograph.
history: 大坑東蓄洪計畫於2004年九月啟用，利用離線蓄水和雨後抽排減輕下游負荷；業主特別說明截流太早或太晚都會改變效益。跑馬地於2017年三月全面啟用，結合地下空間、可動堰與監測。美國環保署同年發布雨洪模型水理參考手冊，提供儲水幾何及流量控制的技術背景。這些公開工程和方法形成比較脈絡，但本課池面積、孔口尺寸與排空時間皆為獨立教學假設，未推定實際工程的控制規則。~Tai Hang Tung was commissioned in September 2004, using offline storage and post-storm pumping to relieve downstream demand; its owner notes that interception too early or too late changes effectiveness. Happy Valley entered full service in March 2017 with underground space, movable weir and monitoring. EPA published its hydraulic SWMM reference in the same year, documenting storage geometry and flow controls. These projects and methods provide context, but lesson areas, openings and drawdown times are independent assumptions rather than actual operating rules.

timeline.event: 大坑東蓄洪計畫九月啟用，採離線儲水與延後抽排。~Tai Hang Tung is commissioned in September with offline storage and delayed pumping.
跑馬地三月全面啟用，結合地下蓄水及監測。~Happy Valley reaches full commissioning in March, integrating underground storage and monitoring.
環保署發布雨洪模型第二冊水理參考手冊。~EPA publishes the SWMM Volume II hydraulic reference manual.

Runoff V=CPA=7000 m³.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=300 s、入流I1=4、I2=6及出流O1=2、O2=3 m³/s，ΔS=[(I1+I2)−(O1+O2)]Δt/2=750 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=300 s, inflows I1=4, I2=6 and outflows O1=2, O2=3 m³/s. Storage change ΔS=[(I1+I2)−(O1+O2)]Δt/2=750 m³.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A(h)=1000+200h m²，其中h以m計；到h=2 m的庫容S=1000h+100h²=2400 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A(h)=1000+200h m² with h in meters. Storage at h=2 m is S=1000h+100h²=2400 m³.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、開口A=0.10 m²、兩側水頭差ΔH=1.0 m、g=9.81 m/s²，Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, opening A=0.10 m², differential head ΔH=1.0 m and g=9.81 m/s². Flow Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h. Infiltrated volume Vi=Aft=10.0 m³.
